payload.proof_nl: Let x be any real number. By the definition of the fractional-part function frac, frac(x) is the difference between x and the greatest integer less than or equal to x, namely floor(x). Therefore frac(x) = x - floor(x).
payload.role_in_assembly: Identifies the fractional part with the floor-remainder expression so that the inequality and equality lemmas can be rewritten into statements about frac(x).
